effects.printed_clause: If Normal/Special Summoned: send a Zombie from hand to GY; add Crying Chaos Spell/Trap from Deck.
effects.lua_implementation: Normal/Special triggers share one HOPT code, send an eligible hand Zombie as cost, and add/confirm a set Spell/Trap.

official_references.matched_structure: Sends/discards a Zombie from hand as activation cost.

effects.printed_clause: If sent to GY as Link/Synchro Material: put this on Deck bottom; draw 1. Only one effect per turn.
effects.lua_implementation: EVENT_BE_MATERIAL delayed trigger checks GY and exact Link/Synchro reason; shared HOPT; sends handler to Deck bottom as cost, then draws.

official_references.matched_structure: Places a card on Deck top/bottom as cost before resolving the benefit.

coverage_override.reason: The Summon-triggered hand send/search and the Link-or-Synchro-material Deck-bottom/draw trigger are the two distinct effects; both records include the shared choose-one-effect HOPT.
